housing-numbers.notes: 6,500 net additional dwellings required 2001-2021 as per East of England Plan Policy H1. Housing distributed across: Town Centre & Central Area (2,000), Shoeburyness (1,400), Seafront (550), Priority Urban Areas (2,750), Intensification (1,500). Document notes 325 dwellings per annum target. This is a strategic policy document - detailed allocations to follow in subsequent DPDs.
